name: NASA/IPAC IRSA TAP and Cone Search (WISE, NEOWISE, 2MASS, Spitzer, ZTF)
summary: ADQL queries and simple cone searches over the IRSA catalogues, including AllWISE, NEOWISE-R, 2MASS, Spitzer and the ZTF objects table, without an account.
description: IRSA's TAP service exposes its infrared and optical catalogues as tables you list through TAP_SCHEMA: AllWISE source, multiepoch and reject tables, the WISE and NEOWISE single-exposure tables, 2MASS point sources (fp_psc), Spitzer surveys, Gaia cross-match tables and the ZTF objects table (ztf_objects_dr23). The same host serves a plain cone-search endpoint (SCS) per table. Results come as CSV, VOTable, IPAC table, TSV or a VOTable rendered as JSON.

auth.notes: Public data need no login; proprietary ZTF data require an IRSA account.

rate_limit.summary: No request rate is documented on the TAP page; its stated timeout limit for asynchronous queries is 3 days.

endpoints.summary: Synchronous ADQL query (GET or POST); FORMAT csv, votable, ipac_table, tsv, json, html
Asynchronous ADQL job for long queries
VOSI table listing (about 165 KB of XML)
Simple cone search of one catalogue table; answered in about 0.5 to 1 s

license.name: Public data hosted by IRSA; the archive asks users to acknowledge IRSA and the individual missions (see acknowledgement page)

coverage.temporal: Per catalogue; WISE/NEOWISE, 2MASS, Spitzer, ZTF and others

agent_notes: Start with TAP_SCHEMA.tables and TAP_SCHEMA.columns (both answer in under a second) to find table and column names. Position queries use WHERE CONTAINS(POINT('J2000',ra,dec),CIRCLE('J2000',ra0,dec0,radius_deg))=1 and took 4 to 22 s on 2026-11-13 for allwise_p3as_psd; use SCS (for example https://irsa.ipac.caltech.edu/SCS?table=allwise_p3as_psd&RA=210.80227&DEC=54.34895&SR=0.002&format=csv) when you only need a cone search. Prefer FORMAT=csv: FORMAT=json is a VOTable converted to nested JSON with <xmlattr> keys. Use TOP n or MAXREC; only MAXREC sets the OVERFLOW indicator.
caveats: Position queries on large tables were slow and variable: allwise_p3as_psd cone queries took 4.4 to 22 s and one ZTF-object cone query 4 to 20 s across repeated runs on 2026-11-13, and a lookup by designation timed out at 40 s. The example is a metadata query that stays under a second.
FORMAT=json returns a VOTable translated to JSON, with arrays of {"<xmlattr>": ...} objects, not a list of row objects.
No Access-Control-Allow-Origin header was sent, so browsers on other origins cannot call it directly.
Per-mission acknowledgement texts differ; the IRSA acknowledgement page covers IRSA itself.
The pages fetched do not state a rate limit or a synchronous row limit.

verification.notes: Exact example request executed without credentials; 0.6 s on 2026-11-13.
